verdict.rationale: Temporal supports Signals/Queries/Updates and Web UI state visibility, which can be used to relay step updates from a workflow (e.g. via Query polling or Signal-based push), and its AI docs mention agent loops calling LLMs/tools, but there is no documented mechanism for streaming token-level or real-time push updates directly to a frontend — Queries are pull-based and Updates/Signals are not designed for continuous streaming. missing for 10: a documented real-time streaming/push API (e.g. websockets/SSE) to a frontend, token-level streaming support, and any hands-on example of live UI progress updates from a running workflow.
